expect(diffColorFor(value.color, ChangeType.ADDED, roles)).toBe(value.added);
added-table-mode.strategy: fc.record({ color: fc.string(), added: fc.string(), modified: fc.string(), deleted: fc.string() })

unchanged-with-any-palette-mode.body:

expect(diffColorFor(value.color, ChangeType.UNCHANGED, roles)).toBe(desaturate(value.color));

const roles = value.hasRoles ? unreadableDiffRoles() : undefined;

accepted-colored-input.strategy: fc.tuple(fc.integer({ min: 0, max: 255 }), fc.integer({ min: 0, max: 255 }), fc.integer({ min: 0, max: 255 })).filter(([red, green, blue]) => red !== green || green !== blue).map((channels) => rgbHex(channels))

negative-degree-rotation.strategy: fc.double({ noNaN: true, noDefaultInfinity: true, max: -Number.MIN_VALUE })

over-360-degree-rotation.strategy: fc.double({ noNaN: true, noDefaultInfinity: true, min: 360 + Number.EPSILON })

helpers.makeLine: const makeLine = (color: string, dashing: StrokePattern, glowColor?: string): Glyph1D => create(Glyph1DSchema, { stroke: create(StrokeSchema, { paint: { case: 'color', value: color }, dashing, width: 2 }), glow: glowColor === undefined ? undefined : create(GlowSchema, { color: glowColor }) });
